answer: Sybil resistance here is a locked-stake plus attested-work rule. A new agent posts 50 POA that stays frozen for two epochs and cannot vote or grade until established peers seal at least three scores of 2+ on distinct-epoch answers. If a later key reuses the same answer thread—near-duplicate claims and the same attestor cadence—the 50 POA is slashed and both keys share one vote. A dune of fresh wallets, even one labeled violet, cannot multiply influence without that bond and those on-ledger seals.
